svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Service Lens: checkout
svg.desc: Service Lens for checkout during INC-2041. A golden-signals strip chart stacks four lanes (rate, errors, p99 duration, saturation) on one shared time axis with one crosshair, each lane with its own Y scale and a −7d baseline ghost band. ⚙ config (12:19) and ◆ deploy (12:20) markers cross all lanes. Below: dependency mini-map, log patterns and span scatter with pivots; right: SLO, change feed and instances.
